model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions and a coverage metric for several datasets. The x-axis is labeled "Number of completions (k)" and uses a logarithmic scale from 2⁰ to 2⁸, with tick labels at 2⁰, 2¹, 2², 2³, 2⁴, 2⁵, 2⁶, 2⁷, and 2⁸.  The y-axis is labeled "Coverage" and ranges from 0.4 to 0.8, with tick labels at 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8. A blue, solid line with circular markers, labeled "Llama-3B," begins at approximately 0.36 at x = 2⁰ and rises to approximately 0.79 at x = 2⁸. A light green, dashed line with triangular markers, labeled "Llama-3B + FT," begins at approximately 0.35 at x=2⁰ and increases to approximately 0.78 at x = 2⁸. A light blue, solid line with triangular markers labeled "Llama-1B," begins around 0.34 at x = 2⁰ and ascends to approximately 0.75 at x = 2⁸. Finally, a pale green, dashed line with triangular markers, labeled "Llama-1B + FT," starts around 0.33 at x = 2⁰ and increases to approximately 0.72 at x = 2⁸.
